item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
Issued at 01:10 PM 28 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesNorte(Vinzons, Talisay, Daet, SanLorenzoRuiz, Basud), #CamarinesSur(Ragay and Lupi) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesNorte(SantaElena, Capalonga, Labo, JosePanganiban, Paracale, SanVicente) and #CamarinesSur(DelGallego) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
